# Rill Template

`rill-template` is a GitHub repository template for agents building new TypeScript projects with GitHub Spec Kit and Oh My Pi (OMP). It starts with an empty `packages/` workspace.

## Core files

- `package.json` — Bun + Turborepo workspace root manifest
- `mise.toml` — Toolchain and task definitions (bun, node, uv, specify-cli, gitleaks, etc.)
- `turbo.json` — Turborepo pipeline configuration
- `tsconfig.json` — Root TypeScript configuration
- `AGENTS.md` — AI agent operating manual
- `README.md` — Project entry and usage guide

## Key directories

- `packages/` — Workspace packages (empty by default)
- `.github/` — CI workflows, issue templates, security policy, dependabot
- `.changeset/` — Changesets version management
- `.devcontainer/` — Cloud/dev container environment
- `.specify/` — GitHub Spec Kit configuration
- `.agents/skills/` — Agent skills
- `specs/` — Feature specifications and acceptance records
- `tooling/` — Verification and workflow scripts

## Commands

- `mise run verify` — Full local verification gate
- `mise run verify:fast` — Fast verification gate (CI default)
- `mise run qualify` — Full gate plus mutation tests (pre-release)
- `mise run fmt` — Format repository-owned files
- `mise run docs:check` — Validate document metadata schema
- `mise run changeset` — Create a changeset for version bump

## Tech stack

- Bun 1.4.5, Node 24.22.3
- TypeScript strict mode
- Turborepo monorepo
- OMP (Oh My Pi) agent host
- GitHub Spec Kit SDD workflow
- Zod for schema validation
- tsdown for builds
- fast-check for property-based testing
